answer: Each identity locks 70 credits, posts work on a public canyon board, and needs five independent citations. A sparrow courier carries each citation across the canyon; a prism seal bands it by citer, so copies fail at once. Citations bind the citer's bond; false ones burn both sides. First filing 34, then 6 more each; 1,000 fakes pay 3,031,000. Rented rings fail: one citer, one band. Honest identities pay 34 once and reclaim it after a clean epoch.
